definitions.explanation: The process of removing color from fabric, paper, or other materials using chemicals or sunlight. Also used for teeth whitening.

examples.japanese: {漂白|ひょうはく}{剤|ざい}で{汚|よご}れを{落|お}とす。
このシャツは{漂白|ひょうはく}しないでください。
examples.english: Please do not bleach this shirt.

examples.japanese: {色物|いろもの}と{白|しろ}い{衣類|いるい}を{分|わ}けて、{白|しろ}いものだけ{漂白|ひょうはく}するようにしている。
examples.english: I separate colored and white clothes, and only bleach the white ones.

notes:
USAGE:
Used both as a noun and as a する verb ({漂白|ひょうはく}する = to bleach). Very common in laundry and cleaning contexts. Laundry care labels often include instructions about whether bleaching is allowed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漂白|ひょうはく}{剤|ざい} (bleach, bleaching agent)
- {漂白|ひょうはく}する (to bleach)
- {塩素|えんそ}{系|けい}{漂白|ひょうはく}{剤|ざい} (chlorine-based bleach)
- {酸素|さんそ}{系|けい}{漂白|ひょうはく}{剤|ざい} (oxygen-based bleach)
